info.title: Job search API
info.description: A REST API over the vault. Each error is an RFC 9457 Problem Details response with a `code`.

notes.description: The count of notes in the vault index.

loadedAt.description: The time that the API built the vault index.

detail.example: The API has no vault index yet.

code.description: A stable name for the error. Clients decide what to do from this field.

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 Problem Details object with a `code`.

applications.description: The applications that match the query. The order is `strong-fit`, `good-fit`, `stretch`, `skip`, then no verdict. With the same verdict, the newest application is first.

choices.description: The values that at least one application has. The query does not change them.

slug.description: The name of the application's folder.

company.description: `null` also if the field has a warning.

title.description: `null` also if the field has a warning.

region.description: `null` also if the field has a warning.

status.description: `null` also if the field has a warning.

captured.description: The day that the application was made. `null` also if the field has a warning.

verdict.description: `null` before the first fit analysis. `null` also if the field has a warning.

direction.description: The direction check. `null` before the first fit analysis. `null` also if the field has a warning.

hasResume.description: True if the application has a tailored resume PDF.

problem.description: `missing` if the note does not have the key. `invalid` if the vault's rules do not permit the value.

Warning.description: A field of a note that breaks the vault's rules.

url.description: The posting on the job board. `null` also if the field has a warning.

analyzed.description: The day of the last fit analysis. `null` also if the field has a warning.

title.description: `null` if the vault has no such listing.

listing.description: The listing that the application came from.

posting.description: The posting, without the fit analysis. Markdown.

verdict.description: The reasons for the verdict. Markdown.

direction.description: The reasons for the direction check. Markdown.

gapsNote.description: The text of the gaps part that is not a gap. Markdown.

FitAnalysis.description: `null` if the note has no fit analysis.

kindNote.description: The rest of the kind cell, if it has more text.

EvidencePart.description: A piece of an evidence cell: text, or a reference to an achievement.

ref.description: The reference as the fit analysis writes it.

note.description: The kind of the note. `null` if no role note or project note has the slug.

title.description: The heading of the achievement. `null` if the note has no such achievement.

kind.description: The group that lists the gap.

body.description: The profile without its title. Markdown.

updated.description: The month or the day of the last change to the note.

profile.description: `null` if the vault has no profile.

roles.description: The role notes, newest first. A stint of a programme is in `stints` of the programme and not in this list.

stories.description: The stories, in the order of the titles.

stints.description: The stints of the programme, newest first. Empty if the role is not a programme.

end.description: The last month. `null` for the current role.

programme.description: The slug of the role note for the programme that this stint is part of.

kind.description: `null` if the note has a value that the vault's rules do not permit.

end.description: The last month. `null` for a project that continues.

onProfile.description: `true` if the project can go on a resume.

roles.description: The role notes that the story comes from. A slug with no role note is not here.

NoteRef.description: A note that a different note names.

updated.description: The month or the day of the last change to the note.

pinned.description: The `Pinned` section of the inventory, as markdown. Can be empty.

categories.description: The categories in the order of the inventory.

unlisted.description: The skills that a note lists and the inventory does not have.

uses.description: The number of role notes and project notes that list the skill.

name.description: The name in the skills inventory. The slug if the inventory does not have the skill.

category.description: The category in the inventory. `null` if the inventory does not have the skill.

end.description: The last month. `null` if the work continues.

items.description: A note that a different note names.

notes.description: Each role note and project note that lists the skill, newest first.

title.description: The first `#` heading. If the note has none, a role note has its job title, its company and its team, and each other note has its slug as words.

body.description: The note without its title. Markdown.

anchor.description: The name that a reference uses after `#`.

achievements.description: The achievements of the note, in the order of the note. Empty for a story.

skills.description: The skills that the note lists. Empty for a story.

text.description: The comment without the tag. Can be empty.

revisits.description: Each frontmatter key whose line has a comment with the tag `#revisit`. A tag in the text of the note stays in `body`.

end.description: The last month. `null` for the current role.

programme.description: The programme that this stint is part of. `null` if the vault has no role note for it.

stints.description: The stints of the programme, newest first. Empty if the role is not a programme.

stories.description: The stories that come from the role.

role.description: The facts of a role note. `null` for each other kind.

kind.description: `null` if the note has a value that the vault's rules do not permit.

end.description: The last month. `null` for a project that continues.

onProfile.description: `true` if the project can go on a resume.

link.description: The web address of the project.

project.description: The facts of a project note. `null` for each other kind.

roles.description: The role notes that the story comes from. A slug with no role note is not here.

story.description: The facts of a story. `null` for each other kind.

listings.description: The listings that match the query. The companies are in the order of their names. In a company, the listing first seen most recently is first.

total.description: The number of open listings with the triage `shortlist`. The query does not change it.

count.description: The number of its listings on the shortlist.

companies.description: The companies with a listing on the shortlist. The query does not change them.

company.description: The folder of the company in the market scan.

slug.description: The file name of the listing record without `.md`.

level.description: The level label from the job board.

reason.description: The reason for the triage. One line.

firstSeen.description: The day of the first sweep that found the listing. `null` if the row has a warning for it.

found.description: False if the vault has no such application.

status.description: `null` if the application does not exist or has no permitted status.

application.description: The application that the listing was promoted to. `null` if it was not promoted.

warnings.description: `field` is the column of the company index.

companies.description: Each company that has a listing index, in the order of the names.

slug.description: The folder of the company in the market scan.

mode.description: `null` if the company is not on the watchlist.

lastSwept.description: The day in the watchlist. If the watchlist has none, the newest day of the sweep log.

openShortlisted.description: The number of open listings with the triage `shortlist`.

listings.description: The number of listings in the company index.

lastSwept.description: The day of the last sweep.

board.description: The web address of the job board.

notes.description: The notes about the company, as markdown. Can be empty.

pay.description: The note about the pay, as markdown. Can be empty.

remote.description: The note about remote work, as markdown. Can be empty.

watchlist.description: What the watchlist says about the company, without the instructions for a sweep. `null` if the company is not on the watchlist.

sweeps.description: The day of each sweep, newest first.

listings.description: Each listing of the company. The order is `shortlist`, `maybe`, then `reject`. With the same triage, open listings are first, then the listing first seen most recently.

triage.description: `null` if the company index has a value that the vault's rules do not permit.

lastSeen.description: The day of the last sweep that found the listing.

state.description: `null` if the company index has a value that the vault's rules do not permit.

region.description: `sg`, `remote` or the slug of a different place.

level.description: The level label from the job board.

firstSeen.description: The day of the first sweep that found the listing.

url.description: The web address of the listing on the job board.

triage.description: `null` if the company index has a value that the vault's rules do not permit.

reason.description: The reason for the triage. One line.

lastSeen.description: The day of the last sweep that found the listing.

state.description: `null` if the company index has a value that the vault's rules do not permit.

found.description: False if the vault has no such application.

status.description: `null` if the application does not exist or has no permitted status.

application.description: The application that the listing was promoted to. `null` if it was not promoted.

body.description: The text of the listing as the job board had it, as markdown, without the title line.

Listing.description: One listing record. `triage`, `reason`, `lastSeen`, `state` and `application` come from the company index.
